story.title: The Arcane Sanctuary — Mika's home base
story.premise: Long ago the mages of the First Circle raised this sanctuary where three ley-lines cross. The circle fell silent for centuries until Mika found it, woke the runes with her first spell, and made the ruins her home. Here she trains to become a true mage — from Novice toward the higher circles — while slowly uncovering why the First Circle disappeared.
story.mission: Path of the Mage: complete the Apprentice Trials of the Sanctuary and rise in rank.

ritual_circle.name: Ritual Circle
ritual_circle.purpose: Casting and attunement on the engraved dais; heart of the sanctuary.

ancient_spell_library.name: Ancient Spell Library
ancient_spell_library.purpose: Stairway down to the vaulted library: study spells, scrolls and history.

meditation_garden.name: Meditation Garden
meditation_garden.purpose: Quiet pond, stone seat and lantern: rest, meditate and restore focus.

training_grounds.name: Training Grounds
training_grounds.purpose: Standing stones and rune targets: practise strikes and spells.

ruined_forest_gate.name: Ruined Forest Gate
ruined_forest_gate.purpose: The voussoir archway where the forest path leaves the sanctuary; fallen stones and an old inscription.

altar_chamber.name: Shrine / Altar Chamber
altar_chamber.purpose: A roofless chamber holding the Heartstone relic, offering bowls and a lore tablet.

watchpoint.name: Scenic Watchpoint
watchpoint.purpose: A raised ruin on the southern rise overlooking the whole sanctuary and the far landmarks.

scroll_first_circle.title: Scroll of the First Circle
scroll_first_circle.text: Where three ley-lines cross, a circle was cut into the living stone. Speak to it gently and it will answer; force it and it will sleep. — Inscribed by the First Circle

altar_spellbook.title: The Altar Spellbook
altar_spellbook.text: The Arcane Orb is the first true spell: gather, shape, release. An apprentice who can hold the orb steady has learned to listen to the circle.

statue_inspect.title: The Gate Guardian
statue_inspect.text: A weathered guardian statue. Its plinth reads: 'I keep the threshold for those who return.' The face has been worn smooth by centuries of rain.

gate_inscription.title: Inscription on the Forest Gate
gate_inscription.text: 'Leave the noise of the world beyond this arch. Within, the stones remember.' Several later lines have been deliberately chiselled away.

chamber_tablet.title: Tablet of the Heartstone
chamber_tablet.text: The Heartstone was the sanctuary's first relic — a crystal that drinks moonlight and remembers every spell cast within the circle. When the First Circle left, they bound it to sleep.

mika_journal.title: Mika's Training Journal
mika_journal.text: Day one: the runes lit up when I cast. Day twelve: the orb held for nine heartbeats. I think the sanctuary is teaching me as much as I am learning from it.

training_ledger.title: Practice Ledger
training_ledger.text: Tally marks by many hands, the oldest almost erased. The newest column is Mika's.

garden_stone.title: The Still Stone
garden_stone.text: A smooth seat facing the pond. Someone carved a single word into its side: 'Breathe.'

watchpoint_plaque.title: Watchpoint Plaque
watchpoint_plaque.text: From here the First Circle watched the roads to the village, the academy and the far temple above the clouds.

trials.name: Read the Scroll of the First Circle
Study the Warding Glyph in the library
Read the inscription on the forest gate
Survey the realm from the Watchpoint

ritual_circle: The runes answer a little faster every day.
If I hold the orb steady, the whole circle hums with it.
Someone stood exactly here centuries ago, casting the same first spell.
meditation_garden: The pond is so still it looks like a second sky.
Breathe. The magic doesn't like to be rushed.
I can hear the ley-lines when the wind stops.
training_grounds: The targets glow brighter when I stop forcing it.
My strikes are getting faster — my focus isn't yet.
ruined_forest_gate: Why would anyone chisel lines off an inscription?
Beyond the arch, the forest goes on for days.
This gate wasn't broken by time alone.
altar_chamber: The Heartstone feels warm, like it's dreaming.
They didn't destroy the relic. They put it to sleep. Why?
Moonlight falls through the broken roof right onto the altar. That can't be an accident.
watchpoint: From up here the sanctuary looks like a single rune.
The temple above the clouds... one day I'll climb there.
Village lights, the academy spires — the whole realm is waiting.
ancient_spell_library: So many spells nobody has cast in centuries.
The Warding Glyph is harder than it looks.
curious: I've walked past this a hundred times and never really looked.
There's always one more detail in these ruins.
